name: SMP Mah'ad Islam Semarang
address: Jl. Citarum Selatan No.9, Bugangan, Kota Semarang

notes.id: Besaran infaq pendidikan tidak tercantum di halaman. Potongan infaq 30% bila kakak masih bersekolah di SMP Ma'had Islam; 50% untuk lulusan SD Ma'had Islam.
notes.en: The education infaq amount is not shown on the page. 30% off the infaq if an older sibling attends; 50% off for SD Ma'had Islam graduates.

source.title: PPDB SMP Mah'ad Islam Semarang TA 2025/2026 (situs resmi)

steps.id: Ambil dan isi formulir di panitia PPDB (Rp50.000).
steps.en: Get and fill in the form from the admissions committee (Rp50,000).

steps.id: Diterima bila syarat lengkap, uang paket dan infaq pendidikan lunas, dan lolos seleksi.
steps.en: Accepted once documents are complete, the package and infaq are paid, and the selection is passed.

source.title: PPDB SMP Mah'ad Islam Semarang TA 2025/2026 (situs resmi)
